blocks.title: Particulate matter
blocks.text: Particulate matter un nanhe maddon ki wasee qism hai jo hawa mein thos zarraat, liquid qatron ya dono ke taur par tairte hain: hawa mein muallaq saari dhool, dhuan aur dhund ke zarraat, jin mein acids, organic chemicals, dhatein aur mitti ya dhool ke zarraat shamil hain.

Zaraye qudrati aur insani dono hain. Qudrati zaraye mein aatish-fishan, aag, dhool ke toofan aur hawa mein phaila samandari namak shamil hain; insani zaraye mein machini aur sanati amal mein jalna, gariyon ka ikhraj aur tambaku ka dhuan.

blocks.prompt: PM10 ko PM2.5 se alag karein aur wazeh karein ke PM2.5 zyada nuqsan-deh kyun hai (exercise Q.2i; MCQ III).
blocks.explanation: PM10 10 micrometres tak ka particulate matter hai; PM2.5 2.5 micrometres tak ka bareek hissa. Bareek zarraat hawa mein zyada der rehte hain, naak aur gale se guzar kar phephron ki alveoli aur khoon tak gehrai mein ja pohnchte hain, to PM2.5 mote PM10 se zyada jalan, dil aur phephron ki bimariyan paida karta hai.

items: PM: muallaq thos zarraat aur liquid qatre (dhool, dhuan, dhund; acids, organics, dhatein, mitti); qudrati (aatish-fishan, aag, dhool ke toofan, samandari namak) aur insani (jalna, gariyan, tambaku ka dhuan).
